about.title:
Our Story.
Our Mission.
about.lead: Since 2005, M-SAYYOD has worked in the mountains of Darvoz with one conviction: the wild is worth protecting — and the best way to protect it is to understand it.
about.p1: Founded in Darvoz, Tajikistan, M-SAYYOD brings together wildlife conservation and mountain tourism. At the heart of our work is the Markhor — the spiral-horned mountain goat that has become a symbol of the high mountains of Central Asia.
about.p2: We guide travellers, photographers and hunters through these landscapes with respect for the land, its wildlife and the people who call the mountains home — always within the framework of applicable laws and regulations.
about.quote: Discover the wild. Respect nature. Experience the mountains.

activities.title:
Experiences
shaped by the mountains
activities.lead: Five ways to experience Darvoz — each guided by local knowledge and a deep respect for the wild.

hunting.title: Hunting Tourism
hunting.summary: Professional and legally regulated hunting experiences, subject to applicable permits and regulations.
hunting.description: Hunting with M-SAYYOD is organised as a regulated activity, carried out in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Tajikistan and the permits issued by the competent authorities. Our approach connects hunting with conservation: responsibility towards wildlife populations and their habitats comes first.
points: Organised only within the applicable legal framework and permit system
Guidance from people who know the Darvoz mountains
Ethics, safety and respect for wildlife at every stage
hunting.note: All hunting activities are subject to applicable laws, permits and regulations. Availability, seasons and conditions are confirmed individually.

expeditions.title: Mountain Expeditions
expeditions.summary: Explore the magnificent mountain landscapes of Darvoz.
expeditions.description: Steep ridges, deep valleys and clear mountain air — Darvoz is one of the most dramatic corners of Tajikistan. Our mountain expeditions are planned around your interests and experience, with local guidance through landscapes few travellers ever see.
points: Journeys planned individually with our team
Local knowledge of mountain terrain and conditions
Time to experience the landscape at a natural pace

ecotourism.title: Ecotourism
ecotourism.summary: Discover the natural beauty and biodiversity of Tajikistan.
ecotourism.description: Ecotourism with M-SAYYOD is about slowing down and seeing the mountains as a living system — their wildlife, plants, rivers and the rhythm of mountain life. Travel lightly, learn from local guides and leave the land as you found it.
points: Low-impact travel that respects fragile mountain ecosystems
Encounters with the natural and cultural landscape of the region
Insight into the biodiversity of the Darvoz mountains

photography.title: Wildlife Photography
photography.summary: Observe and photograph wildlife in its natural habitat.
photography.description: For photographers, Darvoz offers dramatic light, vast landscapes and the chance to observe mountain wildlife in its natural environment. We help you find the right places and moments — always keeping a respectful distance from the animals.
points: Guidance to observe wildlife without disturbing it
Landscapes and light for documentary and nature photography
Patience, fieldcraft and respect for the animals

conservation.title: Wildlife Conservation
conservation.summary: Learn about protecting the Markhor and preserving mountain ecosystems.
conservation.description: Conservation is the foundation of everything we do. Visitors can learn how the Markhor and its habitat are protected, why balance in mountain ecosystems matters and how responsible tourism can support the wild places of Darvoz.
points: Understanding the Markhor and its mountain habitat
Insight into conservation in the Darvoz region
How responsible tourism can support nature

zighar.name: Zighar
zighar.text: A mountain village in Darvoz and a natural starting point for discovering the region — surrounded by steep slopes, rugged terrain and the wild landscapes of Darvoz.

darvoz.name: Darvoz Mountains
darvoz.text: Rising steeply above the river valleys, the mountains of Darvoz form one of Tajikistan's most striking landscapes — a world of rock, ridges and vast silence.

landscapes.name: Mountain Landscapes
landscapes.text: Changing light across ridges and valleys, wide horizons and untouched slopes — landscapes made for slow travel, expeditions and photography.

habitats.name: Wildlife Habitats
habitats.text: Steep cliffs and remote slopes are the home of the Markhor and other mountain wildlife. Protecting these places is at the heart of our work.

conservation.title:
Protecting the Wild
for Generations
conservation.lead: The Markhor is one of the most remarkable animals of the mountains of Central Asia. Its future depends on protecting the places where it lives — and on managing wildlife with knowledge and responsibility.
conservation.p1: Since 2005, M-SAYYOD has been committed to protecting the Markhor in Darvoz. We believe that conservation and tourism can work together: when wildlife is valued, it is protected.
conservation.p2: Our work is guided by respect for biodiversity, respect for the people of the mountains and the responsible, regulated management of wildlife.
conservation.speciesText: Known for its spectacular spiral horns, the Markhor lives on steep, rocky mountain slopes. It is a symbol of the wild mountains of Central Asia.
